semantic.justification: The bounded SfxUndoManager preserves action grouping, compound actions, save marks, cursor-safe failure handling, redo truncation, and the pinned SfxUndoManager constructor default of 20 actions. TaskBG0GG5 ports actual ScUndoSetCell maPos/maOldValue/maNewValue move ownership,represented SetValue,GetComment and getAffectedRange at native source/header boundaries. ScCellValue.release transfers real formulas without cloning and copies literal strings before clearing ownership. Shared SfxListUndoAction exposes native inherited SfxUndoArray.GetUndoAction forward-storage access. The browser current plain-input decoder prepares actual native cell/formula owners at each selected sheet position before writes;source selected-mark iteration uses existing EnterListAction/LeaveListAction so one user input creates one compound action. Undo reverses children,Redo forwards them;browser focus follows the last executed native affected range. Native selected sheets render Writer indigo/slate selection tokens while active state remains distinct. Full ScSimpleUndo,ScDocFunc/ScViewFunc,ScUndoEnterData raw-string redo,formatter/format attributes,change tracking,sheet views,spill/VCL services remain unported;no facade or injected fake provider is introduced. Native ClearAllLevels clears the currently open list payload immediately and keeps mbClearUntilTopLevel until each parent unwinds through LeaveListAction. The root history and save mark are cleared at the top, without a fake physical history owner. Existing ordinary Clear and browser save-token contracts remain distinct. Targeted nested-level tests cover return counts and a subsequent independent group.
